reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text:
Bringgreen is my favourite skincare brand they have really good products for acne prone skin
This is my 2nd repurchasing this eye cream and its actually good I feel like it does something to my eyes I do have lines and dark circles (it's genetics I can't do much about it) and it helps it not get worse I wouldn't say it does miracles but there's difference in my skin around the eye area
reviews.zh:
Bringgreen 係我最鍾意嘅護膚品牌，佢哋嘅產品對暗瘡肌真係好掂。
呢個眼霜係我第二次回購，確實唔錯，感覺對眼周有啲幫助。我本身有細紋同黑眼圈（遺傳嘅，我冇辦法），用咗之後起碼冇再惡化。唔會話有神蹟咁嘅效果，但眼周皮膚係睇得出有分別。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: i’ve always had an oily skin type, but recently as i’ve reached adulthood (i’m 23) i’ve started noticing my undereyes getting dry, raw, and irritated. even putting extra moisturizer on my under eyes didn’t help, and my makeup was looking creased and cracked because of it. i decided it was time for me to get an eye cream and i am very impressed by this. once again, bringgreen continues to impress me. a small amount goes a long way with this, it blends nicely, and i have absolutely noticed a difference since ive started using it. i have no under eye puffiness or darkness, and my undereyes look smooth and don’t crease under my makeup. i even feel like i look younger! i will definitely continue to use this as the aging process starts to effect me in my mid twenties.
reviews.zh: 我一向都係油性肌，但最近開始大個（我 23 歲）就發覺眼底愈嚟愈乾、會甩皮同敏感。就算喺眼底額外搽保濕都冇用，化妝都因為咁出現卡紋同裂紋。覺得係時候要用眼霜啦，呢隻真係令我好驚喜。bringgreen 再一次冇令我失望。少量就已經夠用好耐，好易推開，自從開始用之後真係明顯見到分別。眼底冇再浮腫或者暗沉，望落好平滑，化妝都唔再卡紋。我仲覺得自己望落後生咗！踏入二十中段開始面對老化問題，一定會繼續用落去。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: The BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream is absolutely fantastic, and getting the Double Pack is such great value! This cream has quickly become my favorite solution for tackling dark circles and dullness around my eyes.
reviews.zh: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione 眼霜真係超正，入雙裝真係超抵！呢隻霜好快就成為我對付黑眼圈同眼周暗沉嘅首選。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: Smooth, very nice to put on around the eye area. No irritation noticed, and I think the area looks brighter already. I love that this comes in a two pack so that I don't have to worry about running out for a while. A little goes a long way. It absorbs quickly, and doesn't seem to break me out.
reviews.zh: 好滑，搽喺眼周感覺好舒服。冇出現敏感，而且我覺得眼周望落已經提亮咗。鍾意佢出雙裝，可以一段時間都唔使擔心用晒。少量就夠用好耐，吸收得快，亦都唔覺得會令我爆瘡。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: Been using this eyecream for sometime and I'm liking it so far it's really moisturing works well for me as for delivering results it's not super drastic but definitely can see some difference
reviews.zh: 呢隻眼霜用咗一段時間，到目前為止我都幾鍾意，保濕真係做得唔錯，對我都幾有效。講到明顯效果就未至於好戲劇性，但確實睇得出有啲分別。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: Only used for a few days but my eyes seem a little brighter than before and less dark. The product sinks into the skin easily and doesn’t cause any irritations. Will definitely buy again!
reviews.zh: 先用咗幾日，但眼周望落比之前光澤咗少少，暗沉都減咗。產品好易被皮膚吸收，亦都冇引起任何刺激。一定會再回購！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: I love this Bringgreen eye serum! It is light yet really effective at diminishing my eye bags and dark circles. I have been using it every day and have seen major improvement!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款 Bringgreen 眼霜！質地輕但去眼袋同黑眼圈真係超有效。我日日都用，明顯見到有大幅改善！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Eye Cream 30ml Double Pack
reviews.text: This is pretty good! I’ll finish it, but probably won’t repurchase. It stings just a bit for the first three minutes or so of use, but then it goes away and leaves my eyes looking and feeling refreshed!
reviews.zh: 都幾唔錯！我會用晒佢，但應該唔會再回購。頭三分鐘左右會有少少刺刺地，但之後就冇事，用完眼周望落同感覺都幾清爽！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
